Use.name: All Saints' Day
Use.as: Day of Remembrance of the Dead

Rule.name: fixed-jan-02-si
Rule.comment: Second day of the New Year, a work-free day in Slovenia.

Rule.name: fixed-feb-08-si
Rule.comment: Prešernov dan, slovenski kulturni praznik. Slovenian Cultural Holiday, marking the death of the poet France Prešeren on 8 February 1849.

Rule.name: fixed-apr-27-si
Rule.comment: Dan upora proti okupatorju. Commemorates the founding of the Liberation Front of the Slovenian People in 1941.

Rule.name: fixed-may-02-si
Rule.comment: Second day of the May Day holiday, a work-free day in Slovenia.

Rule.name: fixed-jun-25-si
Rule.comment: Dan državnosti. Marks Slovenia's declaration of independence from Yugoslavia on 25 June 1991.

Rule.name: fixed-oct-31-si
Rule.comment: Dan reformacije. Marks the Protestant Reformation, significant for the development of the Slovene literary language.

Rule.name: fixed-dec-26-si
Rule.comment: Dan samostojnosti in enotnosti. Marks the official proclamation of the results of the independence plebiscite of 23 December 1990.
